item.title: Netflix lays off 6% of workforce amidst slowing growth
item.description: Netflix is regrouping after the release of its latest quarterly earnings this week. Revenue growth at the streaming giant has slowed as the company works to overhaul its programming unit.

item.description: Sacha Pfeiffer visits Port Milwaukee to see how President Trump's tariffs have affected the flow of goods and impacted the regional economy.

item.title: A consultant is going viral for exposing the cringe-worthy DMs bosses send employees
item.description: A management consultant is going viral after he started sharing cringe-worthy anonymous DMs employees get from bosses. Like, ones they get on their wedding day and worse.

item.title: Why Meta is charging to post more hyperlinks
item.description: Social media sites aren't the biggest fans of people leaving via hyperlinks. In fact, Meta has made it subscription-worthy for a Facebook Page to post more than two hyperlinks per month. What's the rationale for companies want to keep you on their site?

item.title: How long does it take to save up for a starter home? Twice as long as it did in 2019
item.description: A new analysis finds that the average renter household now needs 16 years to save for a down payment and closing costs. Rising rents and other costs have consumed a growing share of household budgets.

item.title: Elon Musk says Space X and Tesla are considering a merger
item.description: CEO Elon Musk says both Space X and Tesla have formed special committees to discuss the idea of a merger, but a merger would require approval of 50% of shareholders.
